title: tic.config.json
description: Container modules generated by `tic build` (@ts-ioc-container/compiler). Relative paths resolve against this file's directory.

tsconfig.description: tsconfig whose `paths` aliases namespaces and imports may use. Default `tsconfig.json`, which may be absent.

importExtension.description: Extension of generated imports, e.g. ".js". Inferred from the tsconfig: ".js" under node16/nodenext resolution, none otherwise.

namespaces.description: Folders to scan: paths relative to this file (./src/services) or tsconfig paths aliases (@app/services).

select.description: decorated: exported classes carrying one of `decorators`; exported: every exported class. Abstract classes are never registered.

decorators.description: Decorator names that mark a class as a registration. List composed decorators here.

exclude.description: Globs, relative to this file, of files never scanned. Replaces the default when given.
